title: Relationship Type Definition
description: Ontology governance document defining the approved relationship predicates and their properties for the Life Graph. This schema defines what relationships are valid across all schemas—not instance-level relationships, but the vocabulary of relationship types themselves.

id.description: Unique identifier for this relationship type definition

uuid.description: Stable UUID for API and external references

relationship_code.description: Machine-readable code for this relationship type (e.g., REL_BLOCKS, REL_ENABLES). Used in APIs and code generation.

relationship_name.description: Governed predicate name used in schema relationships arrays

inverse_relationship_name.description: The precise inverse of this relationship (e.g., inverse of 'works-for' is 'employs'). Enables bidirectional querying and reasoning.

relationship_category.description: Category for relationship grouping and reasoning patterns

allowed_from_entity_types.description: Schema names that can be sources of this relationship. Empty array means any type allowed.

allowed_to_entity_types.description: Schema names that can be targets of this relationship. Empty array means any type allowed.

directionality.description: Whether this relationship can be navigated in both directions

relationship_strength_default.description: Default strength/weight for reasoning (0=weak, 1=strong). Can be overridden at instance level.

supports_reasoning.description: Whether this relationship should be considered for AI graph reasoning

confidence_required.description: Whether instances of this relationship must include confidence scores from provenance layer

temporal_context_required.description: Whether instances of this relationship must include temporal-context fields (valid_date, effective_date, etc.)

evidence_required.description: Whether instances of this relationship must cite evidence or sources

properties.description: Additional properties that can be set on instances of this relationship type

constraints.description: Business rules and constraints for this relationship type

examples.description: Real-world examples of this relationship in the Life Graph

version.description: Semantic version of this relationship definition (e.g., 1.0.0)

deprecation_status.description: Governance status for this relationship type

superseded_by.description: If deprecated or superseded, the replacement relationship name

first_introduced.description: Date this relationship type was first added to governance

last_modified.description: When this definition was last updated

ontology_notes.description: Governance notes explaining reasoning intent, usage patterns, or evolution
